description: Apogee Labs is a team of AI and coding enthusiasts from Kochi, Kerala. We're tackling Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data, building an AI-powered crop-advisory tool that turns NASA climate and Earth observation data (rainfall, temperature, soil moisture, vegetation health) into simple guidance for farmers facing changing monsoon patterns. Skills: AI/ML,  web development, data analysis and visualization, UI design. Our team is full.
